sources.title: Vasily Pestun, Localization of Gauge Theory on a Four-Sphere and Supersymmetric Wilson Loops
sources.locator: Full 58-page paper. §1 equations (1.3)–(1.4) and the noncommutative-S4 qualification; §2 equations (2.1)–(2.14), (2.24)–(2.30); §4 equations (4.47), (4.50); §5 equations (5.1), (5.11)–(5.12).
sources.actual_read_extent: Retrieved and inspected the complete 58-page PDF. Read the S4 partition-function formula and its assumptions; the round-sphere metric, N=2 field and Q conventions, Euclidean contour and gauge fixing; the root-product one-loop regularization; the N=2* instanton formula, mass shift and charge-one terms; and the explicit statement that the noncommutative S4 regulator is assumed rather than constructed.
sources.limitations: The paper presents the continuum path integral and localization expression formally; this batch does not reconstruct its continuum measure or determinant argument. Pestun explicitly leaves the S4 noncommutative regulator extension unconstructed, and the matrix expression remains source-reported.
